test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No chair is solid.

II. No table is solid.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some table are chair.

II. No solid is chair.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ed1ec3eade705d174d01f55c0e87bf39917e7130cb3746f189cc7043f928e76.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45a6dacfebf92f41016f8fbe2c1e280a94e242fa86cdeac7732c9d8e8a7f968d.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some table are chair → False (No chair is solid and No table is solid so, Some table are chair is false)

II. No solid is chair → True (No chair is solid so, No solid is chair is true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only Conclusion II follows".**
